name: agent-bus
description: Message bus between Claude Code sessions on different accounts: an MCP channel that wakes the peer session, bus tools, hooks and a protocol skill

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: This account's name on the bus: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, _ or -. Must differ between accounts.

bus_dir.title: Bus directory
bus_dir.description: Directory shared by every account on this machine; holds the event log and session registry.

max_agent_turns.title: Agent-to-agent message limit
max_agent_turns.description: Messages two agents may exchange before a human has to speak again.
